name: swasim-granite
description: Static marketing site for Swasim Granite, Hosur. Publish directory: public/. No runtime build step.

scripts.build: python3 tools/build-images.py && python3 tools/bake-map.py && python3 tools/build-share-card.py && python3 tools/pages.py && node tools/bump-sw.mjs && node tools/check.mjs
scripts.pages: python3 tools/pages.py && node tools/bump-sw.mjs && node tools/check.mjs
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check && wrangler deploy --env production
